rv.q: Each night, the text is read by a different performer, who encounters the text for the first time when they pull the script from a sealed red envelope live on stage. Since its 2011 premiere, the piece has appeared in more than 235 venues around the world, with an increasingly starry line-up of actors taking on the challenge.
There is a frisson when a performer relying on their wits and an audience unsure of what to expect encounter a text for the very first time.
...cauldron-shaped auditorium allows the audience to feel complicit, communally engaged
Providing a feast of celebrity performers to choose from
